title: F3-AGI v4.0: Bioenergetically-Gated Active Inference, Metaplastic Preconditioning, and Residual Program Synthesis for Sample-Efficient Abstract Reasoning
abstract: arXiv:2611.13325v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Few-shot abstract reasoning on ARC-AGI requires inducing algorithmic transformations from 2 to 5 demonstration pairs without task-specific pretraining. Because few-shot demonstrations under-constrain the hypothesis space, program synthesis suffers from the Rashomon effect (predictive multiplicity): heuristic search finds spurious programs with low training error that fail on test inputs, while unconstrained library growth degrades latency. We introduce F3-AGI v4.0, a CPU-native neuro-symbolic and active inference architecture comprising three mechanisms: (1) F3-Metabolic-Optim, combining mistake-gated plasticity, Fisher-EMA preconditioning, and virtual ATP gating; (2) Adaptive Complexity-Guided Program Synthesis (AACR) with a Cycle-3 ResidualPatchSynthesizer and smallest-pair early rejection; and (3) a 512D L2-normalized random projection driving Expected Free Energy (EFE) exploration with dead-signature pruning. translated_title: F3-AGI v4.0：面向样本高效抽象推理的生物能量门控主动推理、超可塑性预处理与残差程序合成
translated_abstract: ARC-AGI上的少样本抽象推理需要在没有任务特定预训练的情况下，从2到5个演示对中归纳出算法变换。由于少样本演示对假设空间的约束不足，程序合成受到罗生门效应（预测多样性）的困扰：启发式搜索会找到训练误差低但在测试输入上失效的虚假程序，而不受约束的库增长则会降低运行速度。我们提出了F3-AGI v4.0，这是一个CPU原生的神经符号与主动推理架构，包含三种机制：（1）F3-Metabolic-Optim，结合了错误门控可塑性、Fisher-EMA预处理和虚拟ATP门控；（2）自适应复杂度引导程序合成（AACR），配备Cycle-3残差补丁合成器（ResidualPatchSynthesizer）和最小对早期拒绝策略；（3）512维L2归一化随机投影，驱动基于期望自由能（EFE）的探索并配合死签名剪枝。在三项实证……（原文摘要在此截断）
tldr: F3-AGI v4.0提出了一种CPU原生的神经符号主动推理架构，通过生物能量门控可塑性、自适应复杂度引导程序合成与期望自由能探索三大机制，克服ARC-AGI少样本抽象推理中的罗生门效应，实现样本高效的算法变换归纳。
en_tdlr: F3-AGI v4.0 introduces a CPU-native neuro-symbolic active inference architecture that combines bioenergetically-gated plasticity, adaptive complexity-guided program synthesis, and expected free energy exploration to overcome the Rashomon effect in sample-efficient few-shot abstract reasoning on ARC-AGI.
